08031 Shalishah {sha:-li-sha:'}

源自 08027; 陰性專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Shalisha 1; 1

沙利沙 = "第三"
1) 在以法蓮山地的一個地區, 掃羅曾為了尋找驢子而經過此地 (#撒上 9:4|)

08031 Shalishah {shaw-lee-shaw'}

from 08027;; n pr f loc

AV - Shalisha 1; 1

Shalisha = "thirs"
1) a district near Mount Ephraim through which Saul passed as he
   searched for the asses
